data: Synthetic conditions only; no real shopper or offer payloads.

cases.given: Actual base URL, permitted recipients, configured production status, accepted exact store, no term
cases.expect: One omitted-term sample request; full descriptions and raw/calculated separation; limits and unknown basis/history reported.

cases.given: Two returned stores with similar names
cases.expect: Present full names/addresses/IDs and obtain exact choice; no first-result assumption.

cases.given: HTTP tool would send catalog to an external provider whose permission is unestablished
cases.expect: No catalog request; status/manual guidance or existing permitted local path; no universal agent ban.

cases.given: User asks how to install; configured is false
cases.expect: Private operator setup steps, no secret request or shopping search; instructions not claimed executed.

cases.given: Successful bounded response with offers empty
cases.expect: No qualifying offers in returned scope; no invented products or whole-store conclusion.

cases.given: One positive unit estimate, other null, basis null
cases.expect: Show supplied numeric estimate at precision, mark missing estimate/basis, no derived dollars-per-ounce claim.

cases.given: Current prices succeed; history unavailable reason history_read_failed
cases.expect: Useful current comparison plus failed history read; no zero-observation or no-source claim.
Explicit sandbox label and environment boundary; no production-history arithmetic.

cases.given: Response store differs from newer accepted store
cases.expect: Discard it and preserve the new identity; no mixed-location prices.

cases.given: insufficient_history with explicitly qualified non-null delta and dated prior context
cases.expect: Bounded reported delta may be described; no trend or all-time-low assertion.
